_readme: Operator control panel. Edit this file (GitHub web or mobile is fine) to pause or steer the agents. Every agent reads it first and obeys it. HOW OFTEN each agent runs is set on its routine schedule at https://claude.ai/code/routines, not here.
focus: PLAYERS (set 2026-10-30 by the operator; replaces the 2026-10-21 LOCKDOWN, whose P0s shipped). The game works; nobody plays it yet. Most players are on phones: build and judge at 390×844 touch first. Priority order: (1) the core loop on a phone (first run, the score right after landing, retry, skill that shows in the score), (2) reasons to come back and to share (the board, medals, the daily jump, challenge links), (3) first load on a phone over cellular, (4) everything else. Read the players' funnel first (GET /coldgas/api/obs/digest → players; `human` sessions only, `auto` is automation) and say in every PR which number it should move. No new foldable/flip-phone tickets unless the funnel shows those players. Keep: determinism, 32/32 naive landings, no brand names, the audits as a gate, no dark patterns.

parallel_focus.native: NATIVE iPhone app (set 2026-11-04 by the operator; a parallel track beside the web focus above, never in its place). docs/NATIVE.md is the plan: Swift + Metal for the iPhone Duo and the Pro Max at 120 Hz, the same sim bit for bit (proved by vectors), Core Haptics driven by the sim (§6). The web game keeps shipping exactly as before; nothing on this track may change the web's behaviour, the Worker or the scores. Cloud agents: build only native tickets that do NOT say 'Runs on: the operator's Mac' under What (0146 shipped; none open today; phase 1, the Swift sim, is bit-exact: docs/NATIVE.md §3); skip the operator_only list. Once vectors exist, a sim or scorer change regenerates them in the same PR (npm run vectors), or check goes red.
